mapper.sql: SELECT s.statement_id, s.company_id, s.account_id, s.account_name, s.statement_date, s.period, s.begin_balance, s.bank_begin_balance, s.bank_end_balance, s.book_end_balance, s.diff_amount, s.status, s.file_name, s.import_by, s.import_time, s.dept_id, s.user_id, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.remark FROM fin_bank_statement s
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fin_bank_statement ( account_id, statement_date, period, begin_balance, bank_begin_balance, bank_end_balance, book_end_balance, diff_amount, status, file_name, import_by, import_time, dept_id, user_id, create_by, create_time, remark ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{statementDate}, #{period}, #{beginBalance}, #{bankBeginBalance}, #{bankEndBalance}, #{bookEndBalance}, #{diffAmount}, #{status}, #{fileName}, #{importBy}, #{importTime}, #{deptId}, #{userId}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )

INSERT INTO fin_bank_statement_item ( statement_id, trans_date, trans_type, trans_amount, balance_after, counterparty, counterparty_account, summary, voucher_no, match_status, create_time ) VALUES
(#{i.statementId}, #{i.transDate}, #{i.transType}, #{i.transAmount}, #{i.balanceAfter}, #{i.counterparty}, #{i.counterpartyAccount}, #{i.summary}, #{i.voucherNo}, #{i.matchStatus}, sysdate())
mapper.update: UPDATE fin_bank_statement_item SET del_flag = '2' WHERE statement_id = #{statementId}
UPDATE fin_bank_statement_item SET flow_id = #{flowId}, match_status = '1' WHERE item_id = #{itemId} AND del_flag = '0' AND match_status = '0'
UPDATE fin_bank_statement_item SET flow_id = NULL, match_status = '0' WHERE item_id = #{itemId} AND del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(trans_amount), 0) AS totalAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN trans_amount > 0 THEN trans_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS inAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN trans_amount < 0 THEN -trans_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS outAmount FROM fin_bank_statement_item WHERE statement_id = #{statementId} AND del_flag = '0'

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 'IN' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS inAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 'OUT' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS outAmount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN direction = 'IN' THEN amount ELSE -amount END), 0) AS netAmount FROM fin_cash_flow WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND flow_date BETWEEN #{beginDate} AND #{endDate} AND del_flag = '0'

SELECT f.flow_id AS flowId, f.flow_no AS flowNo, f.flow_date AS flowDate, f.direction AS direction, f.biz_type AS bizType, f.amount AS amount, f.source_key AS sourceKey, f.remark AS remark FROM fin_cash_flow f WHERE f.account_id = #{accountId} AND f.del_flag = '0' AND ABS( CASE WHEN f.direction = 'IN' THEN f.amount ELSE -f.amount END - #{amount} ) < 0.01 AND f.flow_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(#{date}, INTERVAL 3 DAY) AND DATE_ADD(#{date}, INTERVAL 3 DAY) ORDER BY ABS(DATEDIFF(f.flow_date, #{date})), f.flow_id LIMIT 20

SELECT item_id, statement_id, trans_date, trans_type, trans_amount, balance_after, counterparty, counterparty_account, summary, voucher_no, flow_id, match_status, create_time FROM fin_bank_statement_item WHERE statement_id = #{statementId} AND del_flag = '0' AND match_status != '1' ORDER BY trans_date, item_id

SELECT f.flow_id AS flowId, f.flow_no AS flowNo, f.flow_date AS flowDate, f.direction AS direction, f.biz_type AS bizType, f.amount AS amount, f.source_key AS sourceKey, f.remark AS remark, CASE WHEN f.direction = 'IN' THEN f.amount ELSE -f.amount END AS signedAmount FROM fin_cash_flow f WHERE f.account_id = #{accountId} AND f.del_flag = '0' AND f.flow_date BETWEEN #{beginDate} AND #{endDate} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM fin_bank_statement_item i WHERE i.flow_id = f.flow_id AND i.del_flag = '0' ) ORDER BY f.flow_date, f.flow_id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN match_status = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matched, SUM(CASE WHEN match_status != '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unmatched, SUM(CASE WHEN match_status != '1' THEN trans_amount ELSE 0 END) AS unmatchedAmount FROM fin_bank_statement_item WHERE statement_id = #{statementId} AND del_flag = '0'
